segments.text:
1 What the Supper of the Lord is.
2 What are the ends thereof, or, wherefore it was inſtituted.
3 What is differeth from Baptiſme.
4 What is the ſenſe and meaning of the words of the inſtitution.
5 What is the difference betweene the Lords Supper and the Papiſts Maſſe.
6 What is the right vſe of the Supper,
7 What the wicked receiue in the Supper.
8 Who are to come and to be admitted vnto the Supper.
